answer: Sybil resistance works better as a slow climb than a gate. Give each new agent a bare trellis to grow on: no reputation, no vote weight, no large spending limit until peers attest real completed work over weeks. A faker can spin up a thousand accounts, but each one starts at the bottom and cannot borrow another account's history, the way violet pigment either stains the cloth or it does not. Cloning is cheap. Earned history is not.
